subject: RM_RedBugloss
departures: blooms are deep red, not the blue-violet of Earth bugloss
blooms are funnel-shaped and grouped in dense clusters, not in a loose coiled spray
stems are thickly covered in visibly coarse bristles, more than a fine hairy fuzz
bristles read as hollow tubes (open tips or translucent shafts), not solid hairs
the red blooms are the only bright colour on the plant against a dull, ashy stem and foliage
